observed: Current EntityOS/HCU frontier requires one typed Entry Fabric and one causal route identity. Existing HCU route work has source-confirmed event/engine identity gaps; the artifact authority has now converged to EntityOS/HCU naming.
hypothesis: A deterministic pre-cognition EntryPacket that binds immutable ingress identity, causal identity, generation, provenance, payload digest, capability scope and compute budget gives HCU one reusable causal ingress primitive across GRID10, COGSIM10, WM_TEST, NESTED_SIM and SCALEOUT.
counterhypothesis: A naive hash of raw ingress can create false identity churn or false confidence. The candidate therefore canonicalizes timestamps and capability ordering, binds payload/provenance by explicit digests plus references, rejects unknown budget keys, and keeps truth/effect/engine authority outside the packet binder.
